realized_to_date.caveat: capacity delivering since 2025; consumed amounts not disclosed

nature_md: Three successive contracts (Mar/May/Sept 2025) totaling up to $22.4B of CoreWeave AI infrastructure for training OpenAI's next-generation models — roughly a third of CoreWeave's contracted revenue when the Sept expansion was signed (CoreWeave's total backlog has since grown to ~$129B, diluting the share but not the dollar exposure). Twist in the initial deal: OpenAI was *issued $350M of CoreWeave stock* as part of the March agreement — the customer took equity in the supplier at IPO-adjacent pricing, the mirror image of the usual supplier-funds-customer pattern. OpenAI had previously reached CoreWeave capacity only indirectly via Microsoft.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Purchase commitments expensed as consumed. The $350M CRWV stock received is an investment asset for OpenAI, appreciating/depreciating with CoreWeave's listed price — partially hedging its supplier exposure.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Revenue backlog recognized as delivered. OpenAI's contracts underpin a material slice of the backlog against which CoreWeave has raised ~$30B of debt (incl. GPU-backed facilities) — OpenAI's creditworthiness passes through into CoreWeave's credit spreads (CDS implied ~50% 5-yr default probability, Jul 2026).

observations.notes: 'Up to' values; take-or-pay structure not fully disclosed.

events.title: Third contract (up to $6.5B) takes cumulative OpenAI–CoreWeave deals to ~$22.4B
